{{recipe}}

There are two methods here: the traditional smoking, and the oven smoking method. Both of them produce mouthwatering, fall-off-the-bone ribs.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 slabs baby back [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] ribs (also known as back ribs, loin ribs, back loin ribs)
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]] (if you're doing the oven method, use smoked paprika)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic powder]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 1½ cups [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]
* ½ cup dark [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]], divided
* ¼ cup apple [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|cider vinegar]]
* 1 tbsp salt
* 1 tbsp black [[Cookbook:Peppercorn|peppercorns]], cracked
* Several pounds each hickory and applewood chunks, or chips if using oven method

== Procedure ==

=== Prep ===

# Combine ¼ cup of the brown sugar, chili powder, garlic powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Rub meat side of ribs with this mixture and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
# Combine remaining ingredients in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook until reduced by half. Set aside.

===Cooking===

==== Oven procedure ====
#Place a ¼ cup each hickory and applewood chunks in the bottom of a roasting pan. Place a rack in the pan and place ribs on the rack.
#Cover roasting pan with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]] and place in the center of a 200°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] and cook 6 hours, brushing with sauce every hour.
#Take ribs and remove foil. Brush meat side liberally with sauce and place under a preheated [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]] until well browned.
#Slice into 1-rib portions and serve warm with remaining sauce.

==== Traditional procedure ====
#Place enough hickory and applewood into the firebox of your friendly neighborhood smoker to keep the temperature around 200°F.
#Place ribs in smoker and cook 6 hours, brushing with sauce every hour.
#Brush meat side liberally with sauce and place meat side down on a high grill until well browned.
#Remove, slice into 1-rib portions, and serve with remaining sauce.
